dedupe_keys.name: moveod building level origin destination synthesis pipeline

description: MoveOD prepares fine-grained origin–destination demand for transportation simulations. The Vanderbilt SCOPE Lab team and collaborators combine employment flows, traffic observations, building or point-of-interest locations and Census geography through integer linear programming. The repository publishes a FastAPI backend, React interface and PostGIS-based data preparation, alongside GTFS and optional on-demand fleet loading. The documented source mix includes LODES, INRIX and OpenStreetMap, which gives the current workflow a US-oriented context. Output geography and time resolution depend on supplied inputs; no single released national OD dataset is claimed. Code is publicly accessible free under CC BY 4.0, while source data and external services retain separate conditions. A limitation is that one quick-start demand-loading step is explicitly a placeholder to be replaced by actual generation, and input availability can constrain reproducibility. Simulation uses include producing building-level demand matrices for transit planning and digital twins. It relates to data-openstreetmap as a stated input source. The optional OSRM service, database and optimisation workflow were not started, and no generated demand or calibration result was independently checked.
name: MoveOD building-level origin–destination synthesis pipeline
